question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
WITH rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        wr.name AS region_name,
        wsr.id AS sales_rep_id,
        wsr.name AS sales_rep_name,
        COUNT(w.id) AS order_count,
        SUM(w.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales
    FROM web_orders w
    JOIN web_accounts wa ON w.account_id = wa.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps wsr ON wa.sales_rep_id = wsr.id
    JOIN web_region wr ON wsr.region_id = wr.id
    GROUP BY wr.name, wsr.id, wsr.name
),
max_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        MAX(total_sales) AS max_total_sales
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_name
),
top_reps AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.region_name,
        rs.sales_rep_id,
        rs.sales_rep_name,
        rs.order_count,
        rs.total_sales
    FROM rep_sales rs
    JOIN max_sales ms ON rs.region_name = ms.region_name AND rs.total_sales = ms.max_total_sales
),
region_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        CAST(SUM(order_count) AS BIGINT) AS total_orders,
        SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales_amount
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_name
)
SELECT 
    rs.region_name,
    rs.total_orders,
    ROUND(rs.total_sales_amount, 2) AS total_sales_amount,
    tr.sales_rep_name,
    ROUND(tr.total_sales, 2) AS top_rep_sales_amount
FROM region_summary rs
JOIN top_reps tr ON rs.region_name = tr.region_name
ORDER BY rs.region_name
